Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer question — shorter term for pilot/co-sell

Quick notes from marketplace ops:

- AWS Marketplace supports custom term lengths in private offers, but anything under 12 months is treated as a short-term offer and often requires seller ops review.
- Approval gates: if total expected committed spend over the term is > $200k, we need Marketplace Ops + RM approval.
- Co-sell registration is a separate flow — we can submit co-sell enablement on acceptance but buyer must accept terms in the AWS Console for the co-sell to appear. That usually takes 3–7 business days from our submission.

Options:
1) Create a 6-month private offer with a slightly higher effective price (compensates for shorter revenue visibility). Ops will accept but will flag it for RM sign-off if >$200k.
2) Offer a 6-month pilot as a refundable credit or commitment where the buyer pays a smaller upfront and we amortize credits if they expand to 12 months within 90 days. This reduces approval churn.

Attaching internal approval notes (aws_private_offer_approvals.pdf).

—Vanessa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-21T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer question — shorter term for pilot/co-sell

Finance check: we can support a short-tenor option but need to protect ARR and cash flow. Suggested commercial templates:

- 6-month pilot: 15–20% premium vs. 12-month list price, paid upfront.
- 9-month compromise: ~10% premium; better for buyer and still acceptable for revenue targets.
- If buyer wants true 6-month term at list, we should require a non-refundable onboarding fee to cover initial costs.

If we go with a 6-month private offer, legal will want a short form SOW + explicit renewal/carryover terms. I linked the HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890) — use deal RDW-2027-HL-0042.

—Vivek

Hi Eva — thanks for the clear ask and the PO. Quick update after internal ops/finance sync:

We can support a private offer with a shorter term, but there are two common routes depending on how you want to structure the pilot:

Option A — 6-month private offer (fastest launch)
- Pricing: 20% premium to standard 12-month list price (or upfront payment).
- Marketplace approval: operations will accept; RM sign-off required if total > $200k.
- Co-sell: we will submit co-sell enablement on acceptance; expect co-sell listing within 3–7 business days.

Option B — 9-month compromise (recommended)
- Pricing: 10–12% premium vs. 12-month list price.
- Faster approvals and better economics for both sides.
- Co-sell enablement timeline same as above.

Next steps I propose:
1) If HealthLytics is open to 9 months, I will draft the private offer and a short SOW and route for ops+finance approval (target: 48 hours).
2) If you need strictly 6 months, please confirm if you prefer upfront payment or a refundable onboarding credit structure.

Attached is a redline of the PO that reflects the 9-month compromise and pricing (HealthLytics_PO_REDLINE_20270322.pdf).

If you want, we can do a 20-minute call today to finalize.

Best,
